_comment: Hanabi locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side); translate values only. Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[Reveal]', '[Play]', '[Discard]'), the literal format templates 'player N card X color C' etc., or numeric ranks/token counts. Card color names ('white', 'yellow', 'green', 'blue', 'red') are shown as prose and SHOULD be translated via the 'color' block; keep them consistent wherever colors appear (fireworks labels, card descriptions, the valid-colors list).

_slots.{num_players}: Total number of players in the game
_slots.{player}: A player number (index) referenced in a hint, kept as a neutral number
_slots.{color}: A card color word, or the raw color string the player typed (kept as-is for invalid input)
_slots.{rank}: A card rank number 1-5, or the raw rank string the player typed
_slots.{card}: A rendered card description, e.g. 'a white card with rank 4'
_slots.{idx}: A card position index in a hand
_slots.{fuse_tokens}: Number of fuse tokens remaining after a failed play
_slots.{fw_white}: Firework progress (0-5) for the white color
_slots.{fw_yellow}: Firework progress for the yellow color
_slots.{fw_green}: Firework progress for the green color
_slots.{fw_blue}: Firework progress for the blue color
_slots.{fw_red}: Firework progress for the red color
_slots.{c_white}: The translated color word for white (nested)
_slots.{c_yellow}: The translated color word for yellow (nested)
_slots.{c_green}: The translated color word for green (nested)
_slots.{c_blue}: The translated color word for blue (nested)
_slots.{c_red}: The translated color word for red (nested)
_slots.{visible_cards}: Pre-rendered block listing teammates' visible cards
_slots.{count}: Number of invalid moves made in a row

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Hanabi game. Hanabi is a cooperative card game where players work together to create a series of fireworks by playing cards in ascending numerical order starting from 1. Each player holds their cards facing outward so that all players can see everyone else's cards but not their own.

Objective:
The objective is to play cards in sequence (1 through 5) for each color without making mistakes. There are 5 different colors and each color has cards numbered 1 to 5.

Key Rules:
On your turn, you have three types of possible actions:
1. Give a Hint (Reveal): Provide a hint to another player about their cards, specifying either a color or a number present in their hand. Hints must be accurate and can only reveal positions of cards matching the hint.
2. Discard a Card: Discard one of your own cards to potentially gain an Info token.
3. Play a Card: Attempt to play a card from your hand. If played correctly in sequence, it adds to the fireworks; if not, it reduces one fuse token.

Tokens:
Fuse Tokens: Deducted when a wrong card is played.
Info Tokens: Used to give clues.

Illegal Moves:
Playing a card that cannot be placed properly costs a fuse token. If fuse tokens reach zero, the game ends in failure.

Game End:
The game ends when all fireworks are completed (perfect score of 25), or when the deck is exhausted and each player has taken one final turn, or when the players run out of fuse tokens.

State Representation:
The game state is represented with the following details:
Fuse tokens: Number of remaining fuse tokens.
Info tokens: Number of available information tokens.
Fireworks: Current progress on each firework color.
Discards: Cards that have been discarded.

Your Role:
You are one of the players, cooperating with others to maximize the total score of the fireworks (the number of cards correctly played in sequence).
Although you cannot see your own cards, you can see the cards in the hands of your teammates.
Use hints, discards, and plays strategically to guide the team towards successful sequences.
When it's your turn, your output should be in one of the following formats between quotes:

'[Reveal] player N card X color C', to give a hint about color C of card X to the player at index N.
'[Reveal] player N card X rank R', to give hint about rank R of card X to the player at index N.
'[Play] X', to play the card in position X from your hand.
'[Discard] X', to discard the card in position X from your hand.

Remember, communication is limited to hints about colors or numbers only, and sharing illegal or extraneous information is not allowed. Work together, follow the rules, and aim for the highest cooperative score possible!

state.description:
You are player {pid}. 

Current game state:
Fuse tokens: there are {fuse} fuse tokens remaining.
Info tokens: there are {info} info tokens remaining.

Fireworks: The current progress on each firework color is:
	{c_white}: {fw_white}.
	{c_yellow}: {fw_yellow}.
	{c_green}: {fw_green}.
	{c_blue}: {fw_blue}.
	{c_red}: {fw_red}.

Your teammates have the following cards in their hand:
{visible_cards}
Discards: The following cards have been discarded:
{discard_pile}

play.success: Player {pid} attempts to play {card}. The card was played successfully.
play.fail: Player {pid} attempts to play {card}. The card did not match the current state of the fireworks. This costs one fuse token. There are {fuse_tokens} fuse tokens remaining.

discard.replenished: Player {pid} discards {card}. This replenishes an info token.
discard.cap_reached: Player {pid} discards {card}. This does not replenish an info token as the token cap is reached.

skip_turn: Player {pid} made {count} invalid moves in a row, skipping a turn.
final_round: There are no cards left in the deck. This is the final round.

invalid.generic_action_reason: The player provided an invalid action. Players can only '[reveal]', '[play]' or '[discard]'.
invalid.reveal_no_info_reason: Player attempted to give a hint without having any info tokens.
invalid.reveal_own_reason: The player attempts to reveal information about their own cards.
invalid.reveal_own_detail: You attempted to reveal information about your own cards. This is not allowed.
invalid.reveal_bad_teammate_reason: The player attempts to reveal information about a non-existing teammate.
invalid.reveal_bad_teammate_detail: You attempted to reveal information about a non-existing teammate. Please consider teammates between 0 and {max_player} (Including). Note that you cannot reveal information about yourself, you are player {pid}.
invalid.reveal_bad_card_reason: The player attempts to reveal information about a non-existing card.
invalid.reveal_bad_card_detail: You attempted to reveal information about a non-existing card. The card index should be between 0 and {max_card} (including). You provided {card_index}.
invalid.reveal_bad_color_reason: The player provided a color that is not in the game.
invalid.reveal_bad_color_detail: You provided an invalid color. Valid colors are 'white', 'yellow', 'green', 'red' and 'blue'. You tried: '{color}'.
invalid.reveal_bad_rank_reason: The player provided an invalid rank.
invalid.reveal_bad_rank_detail: You provided an invalid rank. Valid ranks are between 1 and 5 (including). You provided: '{rank}'.
invalid.reveal_bad_rank_format_reason: The player provided an invalid rank format.
invalid.reveal_bad_rank_format_detail: You provided an invalid rank format. Valid ranks are between 1 and 5 (including). You provided: '{rank}'.
invalid.reveal_incomplete_reason: The player provided an incomplete hint.
invalid.reveal_incomplete_detail:
You provided an invalid action. If you want to reveal a card, type:
 '[Reveal] player N card X color C', to give a hint about color C of card X to the player at index N.
or
'[Reveal] player N card X rank R', to give hint about rank R of card X to the player at index N.

For example: '[Reveal] player 0 card 0 color green' Reveals that card 0 from player 0 is green.
invalid.play_nonexist_reason: The player attempts to play a non-existing card.
invalid.play_nonexist_detail: You attempted to play a non-existing card. Please consider cards between 0 and {max_card} (Including). You provided {card_index}.
invalid.play_parse_reason: The player provided an invalid action.
invalid.play_parse_detail:
You provided an invalid action. If you want to play a card, type:
 '[Play] X', to play the card in position X from your hand. For example: '[Play] 0' plays the card at position 0.
invalid.discard_nonexist_reason: The player attempts to discard a non-existing card.
invalid.discard_nonexist_detail: You attempted to discard a non-existing card. Please consider cards between 0 and {max_card} (Including). You provided {card_index}.
invalid.discard_parse_reason: The player provided an invalid action.
invalid.discard_parse_detail:
You provided an invalid action. If you want to discard a card, type:
 '[Discard] X', to discard the card in position X from your hand. For example: '[Discard] 0' discards the card at position 0.

outcome.fuse_empty: The team ran out of fuse tokens.
